questions.stem: Q1. Match the following: 1. Durham’s rule a. A person is not guilty because of insanity if they were unaware of the nature, quality, and consequences of their acts or could not realise they were wrong. 2. Curren’s rule b. An accused is not criminally responsible if their unlawful act is the product of mental disease or defect. 3. McNaughten’s rule c. An accused is not criminally responsible if, at the time of the act, they couldn’t regulate their conduct due to mental disease or defect.
